Name: Traveling Cart Unleashed
Author: arjay0
Description:
[size=3]Do you ever wish you could buy 300 different items from the traveling cart in one day? Are you doing a challenge to complete the community center using only Traveling Cart purchased items? Do you have 8 expansion mods and wish you could see their items in the Traveling Cart? Do you just want a chaotic Traveling cart shopping experience?[/size]

[size=3]Introducing:[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=5]Traveling Cart Unleashed![/size][/color][/b]

[size=3]This mod allows the Traveling Cart's random stock to include [/size][size=1](nearly) [/size][size=3]any object* in the game! Gems and minerals? You betcha! Artifacts? Sure! Skill books? Yep! New 1.6 seeds? Why not?

What about mod-added items? Absolutely, mod-added items are included. [/size][size=1](Nearly)[/size][size=3] ALL mod-added items. If it isn't a quest item and it is sellable, it's allowed to be in the traveling cart stock.
(Note: this may result in "spoilers" as you may see late-game mod items immediately.)

What's that? You want... [i]rare[/i] items? Legendary fish, galaxy souls, golden animal crackers? My friend, when I said [/size][size=1](nearly)[/size][size=3] any object* I [b]meant[/b] [/size][size=1](nearly)[/size][size=3] any object*. Those are ALL available in the Traveling Cart stock now.[/size]

[size=2]* "Object" as used here literally means items with the "Object" item type. This means no furniture, wallpaper, flooring, weapons, tools, machines (big craftables), etc. It [i]does [/i]include all seeds, crops, fish, food, resources, etc.
[/size]
[size=3]So now we have plenty of variety in the traveling cart stock. But the Traveling cart only has 10 objects at a time anyways, so it could be a while until we actually [i]see [/i]any of those items, right?

Not anymore! Also included in this mod is the ability to change the number of different objects the traveling cart offers. (To be clear, this is only referring to the maximum number of [i]different [/i]objects. Each object will still only have 1 (or 5) quantity, just like the Vanilla traveling cart.)

This feature is separate from the allowable stock changes, so if you want vanilla stock only but lots of it, you can do that too.

[/size][color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Configuration Options in GMCM:[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3]Set maximum stock selection:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Enables the "maximum stock selection" configuration immediately below this configuration. If you want to use the vanilla stock size, turn this off[/size]
[*][size=3]Default: On[/size]
[/list][*][size=3]Maximum stock selection:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The number of different objects the traveling cart will have. Whole numbers greater than 0 only. [/size]
[*][size=3]Default: 100 (Vanilla: 10)[/size]
[/list][*][size=3]Allow all items:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Removes most restrictions on which objects the traveling cart can sell. This also has to be enabled for the following two configurations to have any effect. [/size]
[*][size=3]Default: On[/size]
[/list][*][size=3]Change object sell prices:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The traveling cart cannot sell objects that have a 0g sell price. This configuration option changes the sell price on a few objects to 1g to allow the Traveling Cart to offer them. See the "What actually changed" section for the list of affected objects.[/size]
[*][size=3]Default: Off[/size]
[*][b] NOTE: This configuration option changes the objects themselves. Any of the above objects you find after enabling this configuration will have a sell price of 1g even if they're not from the traveling cart.[/b]
[/list][*][size=3]Allow excluded objects:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The traveling cart cannot sell objects that are flagged as "Exclude from Random Sale". This configuration option removes this flag from about 37 objects so that they can show up in the traveling cart stock. See the "What actually changed" section for the list of affected objects. [/size]
[b]NOTE: This configuration option changes the objects themselves. Any other shops that use the random sale functionality will also be able to sell these items.[/b] (Nothing else in the base game uses random sale for these objects, and I don't know of any mods that use random sale either.)[*][size=3]Default: Off[/size]
[/list][/list]
 [color=#e69138][size=4][b]What Actually Changed? [/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]The traveling cart has the following restrictions on which objects it can sell:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]No artifacts[/size]
[*][size=3]No minerals (this includes both gems and the minerals you get from geodes)[/size]
[*][size=3]No quest items[/size]
[*][size=3]No "litter" objects (anything with category -999; these are objects like the twigs and stone nodes you find on the ground, objects that should not be in your inventory anyways)[/size]
[*][size=3]Nothing without an explicit category (category "0"; this includes objects like the secret notes and journal scraps, but also includes all of the artifacts, warp totems, and a bunch of other desirable objects)[/size]
[*][size=3]Nothing with a 0g sell price[/size]
[*][size=3]Nothing explicitly flagged as excluded from random sale[/size]
[*][size=3]No objects with an ID greater than 789 (this means several 1.5 and 1.6 items are not allowed since they have item ids of 800+; this also means all mod-added objects are not allowed since they have string ids)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod seeks to remove as many restrictions as possible. As such, it makes the following changes:[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Artifacts are allowed[/size]
[*][size=3]Minerals are allowed[/size]
[*][size=3]Objects without an explicit category are allowed[/size]
[*][size=3]The following objects with a 0g sell price have been changed to a 1g sell price (if the related config option is enabled)[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3] Artifact Troves[/size]
[*][size=3]Strawberry Seeds[/size]
[*][size=3]Omni Geodes[/size]
[*][size=3]Mixed Seeds[/size]
[*][size=3]Cactus Seeds[/size]
[/list][*][size=3]The following objects that were explicitly flagged as excluded from random sale are no longer flagged as such (if the related config option is enabled)[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Green, Blue, Red, and Purple slime eggs[/size]
[*][size=3]Warp Totems, Rain Totems, Treasure Totems[/size]
[*][size=3]All Legendary fish, Night Market Fish, and Mines fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Sweet Gem Berry, Ancient Fruit, Ancient Seeds[/size]
[*][size=3]Magic Rock Candy[/size]
[*][size=3]Void Egg, Void Mayonnaise[/size]
[*][size=3]Dinosaur Mayonnaise[/size]
[*][size=3]Banana, Banana Sapling[/size]
[*][size=3]Mahogany Seed[/size]
[*][size=3]Iridium Sprinkler[/size]
[*][size=3]Pearl[/size]
[*][size=3]Ostrich Egg[/size]
[*][size=3]Tea Set[/size]
[*][size=3]Wild Bait[/size]
[*][size=3]Wedding Ring[/size]
[*][size=3]Wild Bait[/size]
[/list][*][size=3]Objects that now [i]would [/i]be available that [i]should not[/i] be available (such as Qi gems, journal scraps, and stardrops) have been disallowed from the traveling cart via a new context tag.[/size]
[*][size=3]In total about 300 new base game objects are available from the traveling cart, and all mod-added objects that are not quest items, 0g sell price items, or excluded from random sale.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[b][color=#bf9000]Compatibility
[/color][/b][/size][size=3]Likely not compatible with other mods that change the traveling cart's Random Objects shop entry (if you're using the "allow all items" functionality)
Should be compatible with mods that add new entries to the traveling cart, but the max stock configuration will not take effect for those new entries.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]Should be compatible with mods that change the items explicitly listed above unless the mod explicitly sets the "Exclude from Random Sale" flag back to true or the price back to 0g[/size][size=4].

[b][color=#bf9000]FAQ
[/color][/b][/size][size=3]Q: Isn't this overpowered?
[/size][size=3]A: Yes, but! Just because something is in the traveling cart shop, doesn't mean you have to buy it. If you think it's too OP to get a golden egg in Spring year 1? Don't buy it from the cart. (If you think you don't have enough self control, I suggest using a less extreme mod such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39122]More Traveling Cart Items[/url]﻿ which has a much smaller scope and more sophisticated integration.)

[/size][size=3]Q: I bought an island warp totem before finishing the community center and used it and now my game is horribly broken.
[/size][size=3]A: Don't do that. Seriously, if you're about to do something and you think it might cause problems, don't do it. See question 1: Just because it's there, doesn't mean you have to buy/use it.

[/size][size=3]Q: The traveling cart is showing me a weird item without a name/a glitched item/an unreleased item!
[/size][size=3]A: Unfortunately due to the nature of this mod it will likely expose objects from other mods that are not intended to be released - unfinished items, unused items, etc. I manually excluded all the unused items from the base game but I will not be doing so for every mod with unfinished items. [b]Please do not[/b] complain to the authors of the mods that add the items that their stuff is unfinished. It's not their fault, it's technically mine (but not feasible for me to fix; I'm only one person).

[/size][size=3]Q: Can I use the max stock increase without the stock changes, or the stock changes without the max increase?
[/size][size=3]A: Yes, just disable the options you don't want. The max objects and the stock changes are independent of each other.

[/size][size=3]Q: Can I use the max stock functionality with a different mod that changes the traveling cart stock?
[/size][size=3]A: Yes, but depending on how the other mod is set up the max stock increase may not apply to the other mod's additions. If that happens it's not a bug, they likely changed/added a different "shop entry" that the max stock change here does not touch.

[/size][size=3]Q: What mod are you using in those screenshots?
[/size][size=3]A: The grid-based shop window is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33271]Compact Searchable Shop Menu[/url]﻿. The modded objects being sold are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿.

[/size][size=3]Q: You keep saying "(nearly) any object" can be sold. What items are NOT sold?
[/size][size=3]A: Objects that are not meant to be held (such as rocks and twigs), unobtainable objects, a few flavored objects like roe, quest items (sadly this includes golden coconuts - I'm not sure why this is flagged as a quest item but I wasn't comfortable changing it), trash (why would you want to buy trash anyways?) and a few items I was unsure if it was safe to let the traveling cart offer (horse flute, void ghost pendant). If there's interest I can share my spreadsheet with the full list of what was added and what was not.

Q: What's the maximum I can set the traveling cart max stock to?
A: I set it to 5000 while testing (in the attached screenshots) and nothing exploded. However this will probably depend on your PC.
[/size]
[b][color=#bf9000][size=4]Final Notes[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]This mod was heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1402]Customizable Cart Redux[/url] which sadly does not have an update for 1.6. Customizable Cart Redux allowed for removing restrictions on which items can be sold and the max number of items available. I wanted to keep that functionality in my 1.6 playthrough, and due to the 1.6 modding updates I was able to recreate the functionality from scratch with Content Patcher. (I haven't figured out how to change which days the traveling cart shows up, or even if it's possible to do that in Content Patcher, but if I figure out how to add it I will do so.)[/size]

[size=3]If this mod is too broad in scope for you (understandable), but you still want the new 1.6 items or mod-added items, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39122]More Traveling Cart Items[/url] as an alternative: it has hand-curated lists items from 1.6, RSV, and SVE available in the traveling cart, as opposed to this mod's "everything but the kitchen sink" approach. (You can use this mod and More Traveling Cart Items together, but the max stock config will not apply to the other mod's changes.)[/size]
